parameters.content:
## Keep the discovery record
No selected articles means no page requests. Empty news responses, excluded domains and articles beyond the page budget still reach Results. They are not evidence that the brand has no coverage.

## 1. Choose your brand and searches
Create Queries with the header `query`. Add brand-focused Google News queries, such as HasData web scraping. In Settings, replace own_domain and brand_aliases, set spreadsheet_id and choose country and language codes. List aliases and excluded domains one per line.

## 2. Validate the batch and saved keys
Reject duplicate queries and oversized batches before paid requests. Read Results once and reject duplicate saved keys. Every query is searched again. Existing results are updated, not used to skip news searches.

## 3. Combine articles and limit page reads
Deduplicate article URLs and retain all queries that returned each one. Prioritize articles returned by several queries, then publication date. Exclude your domain and configured domains. max_pages applies to the whole run. Keep unvisited articles visible.

## 4. Inspect mentions and website links
Read selected articles and extract text and links. Match brand aliases with word boundaries. Direct links to your domain and subdomains are checked. Failed reads stay unknown. Truncated text or link lists require manual review before considering an unlinked-mention candidate.

## 5. Review the article queue in Sheets
Create Results headers: `result_key`, `checked_at`, `topic`, `status`, `title`, `source_url`, `publisher`, `published_at`, `brand_excerpt`, `observed_links`, `citing_queries`, `evidence_json`. Filter review_unlinked_mention and inspect each full article. Optional review_status and editor_notes remain untouched. No outreach is sent.

# Review brand mentions that may be missing a website link

### How it works
Search Google News for your brand or product, then inspect a limited selection of returned articles. The workflow combines repeated URLs, keeps the queries that discovered them and excludes your domain and configured sources. It reads article text and links before proposing review candidates.

Google Sheets receives matching brand passages, observed website links, publishers and article URLs. Filter review_unlinked_mention for pages where the inspected response contains your brand but no direct brand-domain link. Pages with links, unreadable pages, truncated content and unvisited sources remain separate. This is a research queue, not proof that the entire page lacks a link or that an author will add one.

### Setup
Install the verified HasData community node. Connect HasData credentials to Fetch search evidence and Read source pages. Connect Google Sheets credentials to Read input, Read Results and Save review queue. Create Queries and Results tabs with the headers in the white notes.

In Settings, replace spreadsheet_id, own_domain and brand_aliases. Add excluded domains one per line and choose gl and hl for your market. Start with one query and max_pages set to 2. Run manually and verify the matching excerpts and full article links.

### Customization
Adjust the query and page limits up to ten each. Change content_selector when article text is missing. Enable js_rendering only when needed. Each query uses one paid Google News request plus selected page reads. There are no model calls or automatic retries. Run one execution at a time. Results updates matching rows, not a permanent archive. No contacts are discovered and no messages are sent.
